facts.name: Elderflower Lodge
facts.beds: Two king-size bedrooms and a twin room
facts.hot_tub: Private to the lodge, under its own covered gazebo, included in the price
facts.pets: We accept one small, well-behaved dog.
facts._travel: Google Maps, 25-26 Oct 2026: walks as Google gives them, except Highdown Hill 16 min (Google lacks the footpath up Hangleton Lane; Sussex Express walk); drives as a range from the night figure to a Saturday 11:00 departure, rounded to 5 above 20 min
facts._beach: Google Maps, 25 Oct 2026 23:35 GMT: walk 38 min (1.7 miles, mostly flat) to Ferring Beach, 39 to the Bluebird Cafe; drive 9 and 10 min at night (K0289)
facts.parking: 3 cars at the lodge, more on the nursery
facts.address: Foschini Nursery, Hangleton Lane, Ferring, West Sussex BN12 6PP

answers.a: Bedding, towels, bathrobes, beach towels, toiletries, Wi-Fi, a full kitchen with coffee pods, and a welcome hamper with eggs from our hens and produce in season.
Yes, free: 3 cars at the lodge, with more space on the nursery.
Fast Wi-Fi throughout. A 50-inch smart TV in the lounge (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video) and a 40-inch smart TV in every bedroom.
Inside is all on one level, with a large wet room and widened doorways. There are 2 steps to the front door; we put a ramp down on request.

answers.q: How do we get there without a car?
answers.a: Goring-by-Sea station is 1.5 miles away (about 30 minutes on foot); Angmering station is 1.9 miles.

answers.q: How many people does it sleep?
answers.a: Up to 6, in two king-size bedrooms and a twin room. A travel cot and highchair are free on request.

answers.q: Is the hot tub private? Does it cost extra?
answers.a: It is private to the lodge, under its own covered gazebo in your garden, and included in the price. You can use it in the rain.
Check-in from 3pm, check-out by 10am. Self check-in with a lockbox. Ask us if you need other times.
Yes. We accept one small, well-behaved dog.
About 10 minutes by car, or about 40 minutes on foot (1.7 miles, mostly flat).
Choose dates and book on Airbnb, or book direct with us: ring or text 07940 796860, or email info@highdownhideaways.com.

rooms.beds: Two single beds, joined on request
Kitchen, dining for 6 and lounge under skylights
rooms.notes: Utility room with washer and dryer

distances.place: Ferring village, shops and the Henty Arms pub

reviews.name: Jeremy
reviews.text: This lodge is fantastic! do not hesitate to book. It is actually better than the photos. we stayed five nights but could easily have moved in permanently. Easily the best equipped Air BnB that we have stayed in, and the covered hotub makes it useable in all weathers. Also the surrounding area is lovely and peaceful, with great beach walks close by. Thanks Luca & Trina, we had a wonderful stay and the welcome basket was amazing!!!

reviews.name: Carol
reviews.text:
Our stay at the Lodge was a great family experience. Everything that we needed was there, with a very well equipped kitchen. 
Delightful areas outside, which we enjoyed in the warm evenings.
The hot tub was popular with all six of us!
Wonderful welcome hamper - particularly loved the organic vegetables, local apple juice and bread.
Many thanks Luca and Trina.

reviews.name: Kathryn
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Elderflower Lodge and couldn't have asked for a better place for our family reunion and long weekend at the Goodwood Festival of Speed.
My sister and brother-in-law travelled all the way from North Carolina to join us, so finding somewhere special was really important, and this property met all our expectations. The lodge was spotlessly clean, beautifully presented, and had everything we needed.
The outdoor space was the highlight for us. We spent sunny evenings relaxing in the garden and hot tub after long days at Goodwood.
The location was perfect—peaceful and quiet, yet within walking distance of the village and beach.
A special mention to Luca and Trina, whose communication was exceptional from start to finish. They were friendly, helpful and responsive, making everything completely stress-free.
We wouldn't hesitate to recommend Elderflower Lodge and hope to return one day. Thank you, Luca and Trina, for helping make our family weekend so memorable!

reviews.name: Lucy
reviews.text: Just wow! Place was incredible. Gorgeous decor, everything you needed and more. Comfortable… home from home. Trina & Luca were super friendly and we received some fresh vegetables which were very tasty. Would definitely return and highly recommend.

reviews.name: Roberta
reviews.text: We booked for a special birthday celebration. Luca and Trina left us a lovely  message with their very generous welcome goodies. The lodge was immaculate and had everything we needed. The hot tub was easy to use and set in the peaceful surroundings was very relaxing. All four of us had a really great long weekend. Thank you Luca and Trina

reviews.name: Helen
reviews.text:
We stayed at Luca and Trina’s place for my mum’s 70th birthday weekend away. The lodge itself is spacious and beautifully designed. We were impressed with how well equipped the kitchen was with pretty much everything you would need to cook and host. 
My niece and nephew loved the spacious garden and of course the hot tub was also a massive bonus!  
Would highly recommend to anyone considering booking.
